name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio:
Ricardo Oliveira's journey in motorsport began unexpectedly. A mechanical engineering graduate, he initially envisioned a career in aerospace, but a chance encounter with a Formula Ford team sparked an insatiable passion for racing. He quickly transitioned from designing suspension components to overseeing trackside operations, displaying a natural aptitude for strategic decision-making under immense pressure. His meticulous planning and relentless pursuit of efficiency earned him a reputation as a highly competent sporting director. 

At Red Bull Racing, Ricardo thrives on the challenge of optimizing every aspect of the team's performance. He believes in empowering his team members, fostering a culture of open communication, and leveraging data analytics to gain a competitive edge. While he values innovation, Ricardo remains grounded in practicality, prioritizing solutions that deliver tangible results on the track. His analytical approach and unwavering focus on the bigger picture make him a valuable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo has a wiry build and a focused gaze that conveys his intense concentration.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific brand of espresso delivered to his office every morning.
